phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F8 Phase B — Bilateral Component Bridge
purpose: Test whether missing bilateral total-F8 cells can be recovered exactly from separately published bilateral F81 trade credits/advances and F89 other accounts excluding trade credits/advances.

source_orientations.domestic_holder_asset: W2; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=issuer; entry=A
source_orientations.domestic_issuer_liability: W2; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=holder; entry=L
source_orientations.resident_holder_to_X: W1; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=S1; entry=A
source_orientations.X_holder_to_resident_issuer: W1; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=S1; entry=L

promotion_rule: This phase may classify a bilateral F8 cell as an exact component derivation only when both F81 and F89 are available for the same holder/issuer/measure and each component has no orientation conflict. Materialization is prohibited until a later exact-rank and immutable-source gate.
negative_result_rule: If either F81 or F89 is unavailable, total F8 remains unresolved for that bilateral cell even if aggregate F8 is known.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery; no feedback, delay, behavioural equation or closure status changes.
